accepted_gaps.title: Resolution-type conflation
accepted_gaps.statement: PSF/Rayleigh width, localization precision, structural separation, and coordinate accuracy are often reported as interchangeable.

accepted_gaps.title: No shared task-specific error budget
accepted_gaps.statement: Technique comparisons do not provide a common auditable record of photons, sampling, drift, labeling, background, and temporal constraints.

accepted_gaps.title: Calibration-to-claim disconnect
accepted_gaps.statement: Quality-control outputs are not always bound to the exact structural claim and its claimed scale.

accepted_gaps.title: Unblinded apparent-gain evaluation
accepted_gaps.statement: A resolution pipeline needs controlled cases with known separations and perturbations before its status can be escalated.

accepted_gaps.title: Overbroad diffraction-language claims
accepted_gaps.statement: Reports need to specify which classical constraint was bypassed and which photon, sampling, accuracy, or sample limits remain.
